title: The six observed-defect drafts restored by the SP-tsb23kev review get planted checks
goal: ST-vwe6kopi, ST-yh5ivly4, ST-qqeojkym, ST-y74y4tpn, ST-fqcy65x6 and ST-frcd5u2m, restored after ST-lhtuyih2 dropped them, each get a check or repro that runs the defect on a planted input and fails before its work, so none selects a test still to write

run:
import os, re, subprocess, sys
ids = ["ST-vwe6kopi", "ST-yh5ivly4", "ST-qqeojkym", "ST-y74y4tpn", "ST-fqcy65x6", "ST-frcd5u2m"]
missing = [i for i in ids if not os.path.exists(f"kb/_self/backlog/{i}.json")]
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "selectors"], capture_output=True, text=True)
none = [l for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if re.match(r"^\s*0\s+NONE", l) and any(i in l for i in ids)]
print("missing:", missing, "| still selecting no test:", len(none))
sys.exit(1 if missing or none else 0)
